subject.title: fix(onboarding): leave session.dmScope unset so the personal-agent default "main" applies

question: Should fresh local onboarding intentionally change from isolated per-channel DM sessions to one shared `main` session, with shared-inbox isolation deferred to configuration and security-audit guidance?
rationale: The diff is mechanically small, but it changes the default transcript-sharing boundary for every newly onboarded local installation; source and docs support both modes for different trust models, so code review cannot choose the intended product/security posture alone.

options.title: Approve the personal-agent default
options.body: Accept `main` for new local setups, retain the shared-inbox audit and documentation guidance, and require redacted real onboarding proof before merge.

options.title: Keep secure onboarding isolation
options.body: Retain `per-channel-peer` as the onboarding-written default and align any conflicting general-default documentation around that deliberate safer setup policy.

recommendation.title: Approve the personal-agent default
recommendation.body: Accept `main` for new local setups, retain the shared-inbox audit and documentation guidance, and require redacted real onboarding proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR records this person’s stated owner direction and they authored the affected onboarding and documentation changes.
